method.population_boundary: Observed residual frequencies use 48 unique-byte ONNX artifacts selected through 48 revision/path records from 40 repositories. SafeTensors uses three immutable family anchors and GGUF uses eight architecture/encoding anchors. Core ML keeps 27 hash-identified public artifacts from 1 catalog source separate from 5 source-pinned generated MLProgram package contracts. These establish behavior only within each named population, not ecosystem prevalence.
method.deduplication: ONNX aggregate denominators and histograms count each artifact SHA-256 once. Distinct repository paths with identical bytes remain preserved as aliases and do not inflate evidence counts.
method.ranking: Observed analyzer residuals rank before validation-population gaps; then affected artifact count, affected operator/tensor count, deterministic closability, and deployment impact are sorted descending. Ties use the stable priority ID.
method.onnx_symbolic_cost_contract: Total-MAC closure accepts canonical polynomials and deepbom.guarded_integer_expression.v2. The v2 IR retains nonnegative/equality/divisibility guards and exact integer division; unresolved guards or absent ranks never receive a numeric substitute.
method.analyzer_contract_binding: Every ONNX residual row must be regenerated by deepbom.onnx_shape_inference.v1.30 and deepbom.dynamic_shape_cost_contract.v2.2; stale or missing analyzer contracts fail ledger construction.
method.reason_histogram_projection: Artifact-specific tensor identifiers remain in the hash-bound compressed sweep. This priority ledger aggregates them into stable reason classes while preserving exact counts.
method.coreml_evidence_separation: Public artifact observations, generated conformance fixtures, and compiled-plan/runtime captures are separate evidence classes and denominators. They MUST NOT be added together or substituted for one another.
method.non_claim: A zero residual in a bounded format population or generated fixture set is not generalized to the ecosystem. No Core ML device-placement claim is made without compiled-plan or runtime evidence.

gguf.population_boundary: Eight immutable public GGUF files selected to separate serialized architecture coverage from GGML tensor-storage coverage. Five MIT-licensed TinyMQA files exercise Q2_K, Q4_0, Q8_0, IQ4_NL, and TQ2_0 strata; GPT-2, OLMo, and StableLM files expand serialized architecture coverage. Actual tensor encodings are read from GGUF tensor headers and may differ from filename labels.

safetensors.population_boundary: Three public, randomly initialized, size-bounded Hugging Face checkpoints selected to exercise one registered dense decoder, sparse-MoE decoder, and recurrent SSM family. This validation set establishes byte-bound parser and architecture-contract behavior only; it is not a prevalence, quality, accuracy, runtime, or license-generalization sample.

public_population.non_claim: This bounded public cohort comes from one catalog source. It does not estimate Core ML ecosystem prevalence, parser-wide coverage, compiled-plan device usage, or executed placement.

compiled_plan_population.required_evidence: A hash-bound MLComputePlan or runtime capture produced on a declared macOS/device/runtime build.
compiled_plan_population.non_claim: Serialized Core ML structure and generated fixtures do not establish compiled-plan device usage or executed placement.

ranked_priorities.evidence: 6 unconditional root conflict(s) plus 543 condition-bound invalid variant(s) across 9/48 artifacts invalidate 1995 unconditional and 400 conditional node outputs, blocking 213 MAC-bearing rows. 1901 dependent nodes preserve unconditional root conflicts instead of being relabeled as generic unknowns.
ranked_priorities.next_action: Repair or regenerate the source artifact and re-run the audit. The analyzer must not compute through a declared dtype/rank/dimension contradiction.

ranked_priorities.evidence: 27 hash-identified public Core ML artifacts from one catalog source cover 12 architecture, 7 task, and 9 precision strata; 22 expose a decoded serialized graph and 5 retain an unread payload boundary. Separately, 5 generated MLProgram packages bind static blob-v2, enumerated-shape, bounded-range, blockwise-affine, and LUT-palettization contracts with deterministic receipts. Neither population establishes ecosystem prevalence or device placement.
ranked_priorities.next_action: Refresh the public cohort through the current parser and add independently hash-bound catalog sources. Capture macOS MLComputePlan evidence as a separate compiled-plan population before making expected-device-usage claims; require runtime evidence for executed placement.

ranked_priorities.evidence: No external custom-domain node outside the source-registered ORT contrib inventory occurs in the 48-artifact measured population. The 1397 observed com.microsoft nodes are reported separately; synthetic unknown-domain fail-closed tests do not establish external custom-domain frequency.
ranked_priorities.next_action: Select a repository-stratified ONNX cohort containing non-ORT custom domains before adding any new vendor-specific semantics.
